At Facelit, we measure what's really going on, treat causes like PCOS, insulin resistance and thyroid problems, and give you a plan built around Kerala food and real life. It's all under one roof, with doctors, nutrition specialists and coaches who stay with you.

Why diets fail

Why Losing Weight Feels So Hard

Your body fights back
When you cut calories hard, hunger hormones rise and your metabolism slows. That's why crash diets almost always end in regain.
Hidden medical causes
Insulin resistance, PCOS, thyroid problems, poor sleep and some medicines can make weight loss much harder.
Losing muscle, not fat
Fast dieting burns muscle, which slows your metabolism. Measuring body composition keeps you on the right track.
Plans that don't fit your life
Strict plans that ban rice or ignore family meals rarely last. Real change has to fit real life.

Know the facts

Weight and Your Health: The Numbers That Matter

Small changes make a big difference, and Indian bodies have their own health targets.

5–10%weight loss can improve blood sugar, BP and fatty liver
23BMI where "overweight" starts for Indian adults
90 / 80 cmhealthy waist limit for men / women
0.5–1 kga safe, sustainable weekly loss

Health Risks Linked to Excess Weight

Type 2 diabetes
Belly fat drives insulin resistance, which leads to prediabetes and diabetes, often at lower weights in Indians.
Heart disease and high BP
Extra weight strains the heart and raises blood pressure and cholesterol.
Fatty liver
Very common with belly fat, and it often improves quickly with weight loss.
PCOS and fertility
Weight and insulin resistance worsen PCOS, irregular periods and fertility problems.
Joint pain and sleep apnoea
Extra weight loads the knees and back and can cause snoring and broken sleep.

Weight Loss Myths, Busted

"Just eat less and move more."
That's part of it, but hormones, sleep, stress and medicines matter too.
"Rice makes you fat."
Portion size and balance matter more than cutting rice out.
"Faster is better."
Fast loss often means lost muscle and regained weight. Slow and steady lasts.
"Weight-loss injections are a shortcut."
They're a medical tool for the right people, used with diet and habits.
"The scale tells the full story."
Body composition shows whether you're losing fat or muscle.

Questions

Weight Management FAQs

What is obesity and weight management?
It's a medical approach to losing weight and keeping it off. At Facelit, it combines body composition analysis, doctor assessment, nutrition counselling, lifestyle coaching, weight-loss medicines where suitable, and body contouring.
Is obesity really a medical condition?
Yes. Obesity is a chronic condition influenced by genes, hormones, sleep, stress, medicines and environment, not just willpower. That's why medical support makes such a difference.
Which weight management service is right for me?
It depends on how much weight you want to lose, your health and what's held you back before. Most people start with a body composition analysis and doctor consultation, and we build the right mix from there.
What BMI counts as overweight for Indians?
For Indian adults, a BMI of 23 or more is considered overweight and 25 or more obese, lower than international cut-offs, because health risks start at lower weights.
How much weight can I safely lose?
About 0.5 to 1 kg a week is a safe, sustainable pace. Most people aim to lose 5 to 10% of their weight in the first 3 to 6 months.
Do you offer weight loss injections?
Yes. Our doctors prescribe and monitor weekly medicines like tirzepatide and semaglutide for suitable people, always as part of a full plan.
Will I have to follow a strict diet?
No. Our nutrition plans use foods you already eat, including rice and Kerala meals, with better portions and balance.
Can you help with PCOS or thyroid-related weight gain?
Yes. We test for and treat hormone-related causes, and plan nutrition and medicines around them.
How do you track progress?
With body composition analysis every 4 to 8 weeks, plus weight, waist and blood tests, so you can see fat loss, muscle and health changes, not just the scale.
What happens after I reach my goal?
We move you to a maintenance plan with lifestyle support and less frequent check-ins, and body contouring for stubborn areas if you'd like.
Where can I get weight management in Kerala?
Facelit offers obesity and weight management at our clinics in Trivandrum (Kowdiar), Karunagappally (Kollam) and Guruvayur (Thrissur).
How much does a weight management programme cost?
It depends on the services and length of your programme. Book a consultation for a clear, personalised quote.
